source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Heater and Air Conditioning, p.1A-16

procedures.title: Refrigerant-12: handling precautions
steps: Refit the heavy metal screw cap on a refrigerant drum after every use; it protects the valve and safety plug.
If a drum or can must ride in a car, carry it in the luggage compartment, out of direct sun.
Never subject a drum or can to high temperature when adding refrigerant.
notes: Following the established practices for refrigeration work protects both the customer's equipment and the serviceman.
R-12 is clear and colorless as gas or liquid and boils at 21.7°F below zero, so at normal conditions it is a vapor.
The vapor is heavier than air; it does not burn or explode, and is not poisonous except in contact with open flame, nor corrosive except in contact with water.
Sun heat raises pressure and can make the safety plug release or the container burst.
Some heating of the container is usually needed so its pressure exceeds system pressure while charging.
